game.kicker: B I S H Ō J O
game.title: Afterlight
guest.nami.name: Nami
guest.nami.greeting: You made it. I saved you the seat by the flowers.
guest.nami.detail_line: You're awfully quiet. Did I catch you thinking?
guest.nami.conversation_line: Come on. Sit with me before the light changes.
guest.yuzu.name: Yuzu
guest.yuzu.greeting: I kept your place. I was curious whether you'd come back.
guest.yuzu.detail_line: Take your time. I don't mind a little silence.
guest.yuzu.conversation_line: There's no hurry here. We have the afternoon.
guest.sena.name: Sena
guest.sena.greeting: There you are! I was about to go looking for you.
guest.sena.detail_line: You look tired. Here—there's no hurry.
guest.sena.conversation_line: The tea can wait until you're comfortable.
guest.riko.name: Riko
guest.riko.greeting: You actually came. Now I have to pretend I wasn't watching the door.
guest.riko.detail_line: Hey. You're allowed to look a little flustered.
guest.riko.conversation_line: So, are you staying with me for a while?
story.arrival: She said she would be waiting among the flowers. You follow the afternoon light.
story.greeting: You came. I was beginning to think I'd have to keep this little hideaway all to myself.
story.monologue.first_impression:
I'd planned to say something clever.
Up close, I could barely remember why I'd walked in.
story.monologue.resolve:
She'd made room for me before I'd even asked.
Maybe I didn't need the perfect answer. Just an honest one.
story.question: So... was it this little café you wanted to see, or was it me?
story.choice.see_you.label: I came to see you.
story.choice.see_you.reply: Then stay a little. The flowers can wait their turn.
story.choice.together.label: I thought we could enjoy it together.
story.choice.together.reply: Together sounds nice. Come on, there's room beside me.

study.intertitle.description: A private thought on black. Tune its reveal, then explicitly continue.
study.intertitle.sample:
I meant to say something ordinary.
Then she stepped closer, and I forgot what it was.
study.intertitle.advance_hint: The first action reveals the text. The next action continues.

episode.title: The Address Beyond
episode.undeliverable:
The address existed. The sender did not.
On my last delivery of the day, I carried the letter into Afterlight House.
episode.across_the_threshold: Warm air drifted out of the conservatory. As I crossed the threshold, the glass seal on the envelope flashed white.
episode.eyes_on_nami:
Easy. That was quite a flash.
Can you see me? Good. Welcome to Afterlight House.
episode.no_ordinary_post:
I'm Nami. I look after the house.
Yuzu handles the odd mail—and yours just tried to light up my hallway.
episode.a_glass_record:
Memory glass. It holds a message until it reaches the right place.
The address says our reading room.
episode.no_forwarding_address:
Of course it does. The one room we sealed this morning.
Couldn't it have wanted the kitchen?
episode.courier_offer:
That seal isn't done with us.
Staying for the trouble, courier?
episode.choice.help_first: I'll help. Point me at the trouble.
episode.choice.tea_first: Does emergency duty come with tea?
episode.courier_reply.help_first:
Thanks. I thought I'd have to argue with the mail alone.
Stay close. We'll find out what it wants.
episode.courier_reply.tea_first:
Tea and biscuits. Fine, you've found my emergency budget.
Help us untangle this, and I'll guard your share.
episode.one_more_minute:
I had planned to hand it over and leave.
Then I noticed the seal was still getting brighter.
episode.a_second_line:
There's a warning under the address. Too faint to read.
Nami, hold it near the window.
episode.caught_in_the_light:
Here. The light's catching it now.
Don't move the envelope. Yuzu, can you make out the words?
episode.the_warning:
This is no memory in the glass. It's an invitation.
The old records call its sender the Keeper of Unclaimed Names.
episode.verified_trouble:
Then we decline. Firmly.
And nobody opens that seal. We deal with the address together.
episode.keep_the_wards_lit:
The station wards keep both sides apart. Two of their lamps are failing.
If we repair the line, the Keeper loses the address it used to reach us.
episode.divide_the_work:
I'll take the lever. Yuzu, get Sena to the reading room.
And courier—keep that letter with you. We're not done with it.
episode.sena_takes_over:
I heard "sealed room" and came running.
Please tell me this is the kind of emergency that needs a toolbox.
episode.the_useful_kind:
The useful kind. We're rerouting the station feed.
You can admire your work after the lamps stop flickering.
episode.reading_room:
The reading room waited behind its unsealed door.
Afternoon light lay across the tables; a warning lamp blinked beyond the shelves.
episode.a_live_line:
Panel's open. Riko is back from the station with the ward monitor.
Keep that seal off my tools, courier. I like them unenchanted.
episode.riko_on_the_glass:
Riko. I cleared the platform and came straight here.
The south ward is still blinking like it wants applause. What's your plan?
episode.two_green_lamps:
Nami is opening the bypass. Watch the two green lamps on your monitor.
When both hold steady, Sena can disconnect the damaged feed.
episode.waiting_for_the_signal:
One green. The return channel is still locked.
Courier, take the letter into the relay laboratory. Eira can read it on the private line.
episode.hold_the_message:
Beyond the reading room, the relay laboratory hums around its memory-glass instruments.
A framed display floats above the bench. The woman on it looks up.
episode.follow_the_diagram:
Eira cleared the channel? Good. Hold the letter there; its lines match these terminals.
Yuzu, check me: south feed, then return.
episode.checked_twice:
South feed, then return. That's correct.
Hands off until Riko gives the signal. We can afford one careful breath.
episode.the_signal:
Two green. Eira's channel and Nami's bypass are holding.
Steady... steady... now, Sena!
episode.the_reroute:
South feed out. Return connected.
There. A perfectly respectable repair, with absolutely no explosions.
episode.steady_at_last:
It pulled you through just before the address closed. One last attempt.
The warning lamp is off now. Riko, does the ward hold?
episode.all_clear:
Bright and steady. The station has given the all-clear.
Can we put this monitor down before Sena names the repair after herself?
episode.riko_signs_off:
I'm putting the kettle on.
And don't lose our courier. I still owe him a hello without warning lamps.
episode.a_modest_name:
"The Sena Method" would have been very modest.
But I will settle for tea, and all of us keeping our names.
episode.back_to_the_house:
By the time we returned, the conservatory windows had turned gold.
Riko was already at the table, stealing the first biscuit.
episode.everyone_accounted_for:
Bypass secured. Everyone accounted for.
That includes you, courier. Sit down before somebody gives you another job.
episode.a_proper_hello:
Riko. Let's try that again, with fewer emergencies.
You picked a good day to visit. Usually we make guests wait until after tea for the trouble.
episode.the_unsigned_entry:
Tomorrow's visitor ledger has a new line. An arrival time, but no name.
This ink is warm. I do not think the Keeper wrote it.
episode.the_next_arrival:
The wards hold. The letter stays unsigned.
Tomorrow, someone else will knock. This time, we will open the door together.

study.motion.title: Actor Motion
study.motion.description: Walk away to either side, or bounce in place to show a restless reaction.
study.motion.hint.walk_away: A horizontal departure with gentle footsteps. The actor leaves the scene; Restore actor brings her back.
study.motion.hint.walk_away_right: The same departure in the opposite direction. Pause holds the exact pose; Replay begins again.
study.motion.hint.restless_bounce: A vertical emotional reaction in place. The actor stays visible and returns to her starting position.
study.puff.title: Manpu animation
study.puff.description: Compare transient puffs, stepped motion, and looping fixture frames in 2D or 3D.
study.puff.hint.static: The puff stays until Reset. Trigger presents the same persistent mark.
study.puff.hint.shake: Trigger replays a short shake. The mark stays after it settles.
study.puff.hint.one_shot: Trigger again before it fades. Every puff has its own lifetime.
episode.scarlet_pressure:
The seal warms against my palm.
The air bends inward, as if the room has taken a breath and forgotten to let go.
episode.between_addresses:
For one impossible step, there is no floor.
Then my feet find it again. The hand holding mine does not.
episode.the_unlit_house:
A hall of chained iron doors stretches into the dark.
Heat seeps through the floor grilles. At the far end, a red window burns without a sky.
episode.the_price_of_return:
Leave your name in my ledger, and I will open the way home.
One signature. A small price for a door.
episode.a_name_is_not_consent:
You sent a letter with no sender.
I think I will keep my name until you offer yours.
episode.the_room_refuses:
The Keeper's smile sharpens. Every locked door shudders at once.
Something presses against the far side of the air.
episode.nami_beyond_the_wall:
Can you hear me? Do not answer anything in there.
Squeeze the seal. Follow the warmth. I am still holding on.
episode.follow_the_warmth:
There. A gentle warmth, nothing like the heat beneath this floor.
I turn away from the Keeper and follow Nami's grip.
episode.the_return:
The endless hall folds into a line of red light.
Then the reading-room floor rises to meet my feet.
episode.a_hand_to_hold: Nami is right in front of me. Her outstretched hand is the only thing that feels real.
episode.only_a_second:
You were gone for a second. One second!
Next time a letter tries to steal you, at least let me come along.
episode.the_keeper:
At last. A courier who can cross an address that does not exist.
I am the Keeper. You are standing in the space between every door you failed to find.
episode.the_seal_answers:
Two green lamps. I knew you could do it.
Let me take the letter—wait. Why is the seal getting warm again?
guest.eira.name: Eira
episode.eira_on_the_relay:
I'm Eira, a relay researcher at the central exchange.
Don't startle if my picture flickers. That's the long line, not a haunting.
episode.a_voice_in_the_glass:
That is reassuring. The letter has been changing its own address.
Can you tell us where the return channel is supposed to go?
episode.the_return_channel:
It runs backwards through the damaged ward. I can release it from here.
Tell Sena: south feed out, then return. Wait for two steady green lamps.
episode.one_private_question:
And the invitation inside it?
Is someone waiting for me to answer?
episode.follow_the_pulse:
An invitation doesn't make you anyone's guest. You haven't agreed to go.
If the seal pulls, follow the warmth of someone who is actually beside you.
episode.eira_signs_off:
There. The channel is open; the rest is in your friends' hands.
Call again on an ordinary day, courier. I'd like an introduction without an evacuation.
episode.relay_return:
The floating display goes dark. Beyond the door, Riko is counting the lamp flashes.
I return to the others with Eira's instructions, and one warning I intend to remember.
study.burst.title: Radial Sprite Burst
study.burst.description: Interchangeable sprites share one outward pop, dispersion, and fade.
study.burst.hint: New emissions use the selected settings. Existing bursts keep their own timing.
study.blackout.title: Background Blackout
study.blackout.description: Fade only the scenery to black while the character stays unchanged.
study.blackout.hint: Black stays until restored. Change direction at any point without changing the character.
study.motion.hint.quick_approach: Move toward the other actor, stop at the chosen distance, and hold.
study.cast_pan.title: Cast Pan
study.cast_pan.description: Move the whole cast while the scenery and interface stay fixed.
study.cast_pan.hint: Choose an actor to bring her to the anchor. Choose again during motion to retarget smoothly.
study.puff.hint.step_loop: Held transform steps repeat until removed.
study.puff.hint.two_frame_loop: Two different existing marks are fixture frames, not final animation artwork.
study.puff.hint.three_frame_loop: Three different existing marks prove frame timing and replay without new artwork.
study.puff.hint.sweat_drop: A brief sweat drop falls from the temple and fades away. Each trigger is independent.
episode.a_touch_that_stays:
Just your fingertip. Right here.
If that letter pulls you away again, I'll pull you back.
study.ambient.title: Ambient Particles
study.ambient.description: Continuous world-space sprites, from quiet dust to smoke and rising embers.
study.ambient.hint: Dust, smoke and embers share one emitter contract. The background and particles follow the same camera.
study.transmission_voice.title: Transmission Voice Processing
study.transmission_voice.description: Compare the same prepared voice with and without transmission processing.
study.transmission_voice.unavailable: This prepared voice is unavailable; no audio is generated here.
study.transmission_voice.hint: Switch Original / Processed during playback; the source voice continues at the same position.
